params.body:
## What happened

Merging #204 at 03:07 UTC started the auto-deploy, which runs the test suite in the app directory on the box before it rolls out.

- **Production was opened by the tests.** 13 test files never set `TW_DB_PATH` but reach `db.mjs` through the code they test. On the box, the default path `store/signals.db` is production.
- **The migration ran on production at 03:08:16**, during the test run. It did exactly what the read-only simulation predicted: 98,033 signals, 16 posts, 72 trends, 21,588 gold rows.
- **The tests then failed** on `database is locked`, contending with the live pipeline. The deploy rolled back to #203.
- **The result: old code on migrated data.** Nothing is lost, and `cohort_split_undo` holds every changed row. But the old classifier writes lifestages into `generation_tags` again, and the migration is recorded as done.

The risk is as old as those 13 files: every deploy's test run has opened production. It only showed now because a migration landed before a rollback.

## The fix

- **One function decides the database path.** `packages/core/db-path.mjs` answers which database a process opens: `TW_DB_PATH` if set, otherwise `store/signals.db`. Under the Node test runner (`NODE_TEST_CONTEXT`, set in every test process), a process without `TW_DB_PATH` gets its own empty database in a temporary directory. `TW_DB_PATH` is then set to it, so every module in the process and any child it spawns agree. Every module that chose a path uses it now: db, store, engine, self-improve, the evals, proveml-bridge, the two repair scripts, the query endpoint, and `/elixir`, which keeps its `APP_DIR` default outside tests.
- **A catch-up split.** `cohorts-split-catchup-2026-09-26` and `cohorts-split-insights-catchup-2026-09-26` run the same idempotent split once more, for rows the old code wrote in the old shape between the rollback and this deploy.

## Proof

The whole suite ran with `store/signals.db` held under an exclusive lock by another process, as production is during a deploy:

| Run | Result | `store/signals.db` |
|---|---|---|
| With the guard | 927 of 927 pass | byte-identical |
| Guard disabled | 20 fail, 9 of them `database is locked` | locked, as on the box |

`test/db-path.test.mjs` pins the rule: under the test runner a process never gets `store/signals.db`, and `TW_DB_PATH` always wins.

## After merge

- **This deploy's test run can no longer touch production,** so it should pass and roll out #204 together with this change.
- **The catch-up then splits what the old code wrote since 03:08.** I will read the migration notes on the box afterwards.
params.title: A test never opens the real database
